correctness.rationale: All nonempty rook faces have trivial stabilizer under the cyclic 3-row rotation: each occupied column has exactly one selected row. Quotient orbit cells are n vertices, n(n-1) oriented edges, 2*C(n,3) triangles with the displayed integral boundary signs. The spanning-tree cycle basis eliminates triangle variables and leaves H1=<x2,...,xn | xi+xj+xk=0, 2<=i<j<k<=n>. For n=3 no relations gives Z^2, for n=4 one primitive triple relation gives Z^2, and n>=5 has at least four generators so pair-sharing differences force all xi equal and 3x=0 with a map to Z/3 proving exact order. At n=3 free-edge simplicial collapses give wedge S1∨S1; n=4 original chessboard surface is torus and odd-order orientation-preserving covering keeps torus. For n>=5 classic chessboard connectivity gives simply connected cover, hence π1 quotient C3; top H2 is free as kernel of integer ∂2 and its rank is χ-1=n(n-2)(n-4)/3-1. Direct integral presentation is all-width proof; bounded Smith checks n=3..10 independently corroborate.
